groups.defect: fetch_error_details pairs error IDs with nodestore mapping values positionally, potentially associating IDs with the wrong event data.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same zip(error_ids, events.values()) defect. Missing, reordered, or deduplicated results are different triggers for the same alignment failure, resolved by matching by node ID.

groups.defect: The age/timestamp validators use truthiness instead of presence checks for mutual exclusion and fail to require either field.
groups.rationale: All four report the same falsy-value exclusion defect in the same validators. s_06a69ac5 additionally reports acceptance of reports containing neither field, which must survive in the merged comment.

groups.defect: The feature-flagged dashboard table branch passes hardcoded empty columns and data instead of the fetched query results.
groups.rationale: Both report the same placeholder props causing empty tables for flagged organizations. Wiring the query results into this branch addresses both.
